```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
library(glmmTMB)
library(gt) #for saving tables in a word doc
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot

```

```{r}
lom <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Lomatium_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2026.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}"))#%>% 
  #select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))

#scott used size.t = log(No.leaves.t * Leaf.length.t) as the size measurement
lom <- left_join(lom, climate, by = c("Year" = "year"))
lom <- lom %>% 
  group_by(plantid) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year), 
         Plot = as.factor(Plot),
          psurvival = factor(psurvival, levels = c(0, 1)),
          psurvivalT1 = as.character(psurvivalT1),
         psurvivalT1 = factor(psurvivalT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflower = factor(pflower, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pflowerT1 = factor(pflowerT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
         pseeds = factor(pseeds, levels = c(0, 1)),
    size = if_else(No.leaves > 0& Leaf.length>0, log(No.leaves* Leaf.length), NA),
         sizeT1 = lead(size),
    trt = as.factor(trt),
    trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought")) %>% 
  filter(Plot != "11",
         Year != "2016") #no. leaves were miscounted

lom.surv <- lom %>% 
  filter(!Year %in% c("2025", "2026"),
  !is.na(psurvivalT1))

seeds <- lom %>% 
  filter(!is.na(no.seeds))

test <- lom %>% count(Tag)

```

```{r}
#get pop sizes year to year and lambda
lam <- lom %>%
  filter(Xcoor < 10) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%  # fix ordering
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(psurvival == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Plot, Year) %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = lead(n) / n
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

lam.all <- lom %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(psurvival == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = lead(n) / n
  )
(lambda <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())
(n <- ggplot(lam, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = n, color = Plot)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())
(to <- lambda/n +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)

(n.size <- 
  lam.all %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of plants") +
  theme_minimal())

(lambda.size <- ggplot(lam.all, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = lambda, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1)+
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(lambda)) +
  theme_minimal())

(to.size
  <- lambda.size/n.size +plot_layout(guides = "collect")
)
ggsave(here("Figures", "Lomatium", "groundtruth.lambda.png"), plot = to, width = 8, height =6)
ggsave(here("Figures", "Lomatium", "groundtruth.lambda.plots pooled.png"), plot = to.size, width = 8, height =6)

```


```{r}
#size in current year or past year for flowering
lom_complete <- lom[complete.cases(lom[, c("pflower", "pflowerT1", "size", "Year", "Plot")]), ]
f.test1  <- glmer(pflower ~ size+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = lom_complete, family = "binomial")
f.test2  <- glmer(pflowerT1 ~ size+ (1|Year) + (1|Plot) , data = lom_complete, family = "binomial")
AIC(f.test1, f.test2) #one is better
```

```{r growth prequel}
base <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*Year + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
drop1(base,test="Chisq")
# base2 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+Year + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
# base3 <- lmer(log.no.stemsT1 ~ log.no.stems+ (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)
# a2 <- anova(base3, base2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
best.growth <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = lom, REML = F)

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.growth)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))%>% 
  rename(int = `(Intercept)`)

# 
grow.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)

# Compute correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(names(grow.corr), function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(grow.corr$int, grow.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_growth <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_growth <- cor_results_growth[order(-abs(cor_results_growth$correlation)), ]
#prev_spring.tot.precip

###
#these are the ones to test
vars <- c("summer.mean.min.temp", "prev_spring.mean.min.temp")

# Unique climate-year values
lom.unique <- lom %>%
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct(Year, across(all_of(vars)))

# All pairwise combinations
pairs <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE)

cor_results <- map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
  x <- lom.unique[[p[1]]]
  y <- lom.unique[[p[2]]]
  ct <- cor.test(x, y)
  tibble(
    var1 = p[1],
    var2 = p[2],
    estimate = unname(ct$estimate),
    statistic = unname(ct$statistic),
    p.value = ct$p.value,
    conf.low = ct$conf.int[1],
    conf.high = ct$conf.int[2]
  )
})

cor_results
pairs <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE)

pairs
#dont test these together...correlated!

```


```{r growth model selection}
gm.base.size <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.base.trt <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size+ trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.base.trt.int <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)

# ##grow season total precip

gm.ps.temp <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size  + prev_spring.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.q <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size  + prev_spring.mean.min.temp + I(prev_spring.mean.min.temp^2) + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.int <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size *prev_spring.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.trt <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size  + prev_spring.mean.min.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.trt.int1 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size *prev_spring.mean.min.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.trt.int2 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size  + prev_spring.mean.min.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.trt.int3 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + prev_spring.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.ps.temp.trt.int4 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + trt*prev_spring.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)

# #summer.mean.min.temp
gm.s.min.temp <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.q <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + summer.mean.min.temp + I(summer.mean.min.temp^2) + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.int <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.trt <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + summer.mean.min.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.trt.int1 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*summer.mean.min.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.trt.int2 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size + summer.mean.min.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.trt.int3 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4 <- lmer(sizeT1 ~ size*trt + trt*summer.mean.min.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, REML = F)
################################################################################
###
growth <- mget(ls(pattern = "^gm")) #make a list of all of those models that start with gm (^ means start with)
growth_AICc<-aictab(cand.set = growth, modnames = NULL,second.ord=TRUE,nobs=NULL,sort=TRUE)

#rm(list = ls()[grepl("gm", ls())]) #removes everything with gm


summary(gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4)
```

```{r save growth}
growth_AICc2 <- growth_AICc |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |> 
  arrange(AICc)

get_fixed_formula <- function(m) {
  f <- formula(m)
  rhs <- deparse(f[[3]], width.cutoff = 500)
  rhs <- paste(rhs, collapse = "")
  rhs <- gsub("\\s*\\+?\\s*\\(1\\s*\\|\\s*\\w+\\)", "", rhs)
  trimws(rhs)
}

fixed_formulas <- sapply(growth, get_fixed_formula)

growth_AICc2$fixed_effects <- fixed_formulas[growth_AICc2$Modnames]


growth.d <- growth_AICc2 %>% 
  rename(Model = Modnames) %>% 
  relocate(fixed_effects, .before =1) |> 
  select(c(1, 3, 4, 5))
  #filter(Rank %in% c(1:10, 43)) #also show the intercept only model

growth.d %>% gt() %>% gtsave(here("Tables", "Lomatium", "Lomatium.AIC.table.growth.docx"))

#save the best fit model
summary(gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4)
coefs <- summary(gm.s.min.temp.trt.int4)$coefficients

g.coef <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(coefs),
  Estimate = coefs[, "Estimate"],
  SE = coefs[, "Std. Error"]
)

write.csv(g.coef, here("Tables", "Lomatium", "lomatium_growth_best_fit_coeff.csv"), row.names = F)
```

```{r pflower prequel}
table(lom$pflower, lom$Year)
base.p <- glmer(pflower ~ size*Year + (1|Plot) , data = lom, family = "binomial", control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
drop1(base.p,test="Chisq") 
#keep interaction terms between size and climate
best.pflower <- glmer(pflower ~ size + (1|Year) + (1|Plot), data = lom, family = "binomial")


re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(best.pflower)$Year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))%>% 
  rename(int = `(Intercept)`)

pflower.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)

# get correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(names(pflower.corr), function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(pflower.corr$int, pflower.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

# Combine into one data frame
cor_results_pflower <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)
cor_results_pflower$p_value <- format(cor_results_pflower$p_value, scientific = FALSE)

```

```{r pflower model selection}
fm.base.size <- glmer(pflower ~ size + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.base.trt <- glmer(pflower ~ size+ trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")

fm.wt.int <- glmer(pflower ~ size *winter.mean.max.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.wt.trt <- glmer(pflower ~ size  + winter.mean.max.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.wt.trt.int1 <- glmer(pflower ~ size *winter.mean.max.temp + trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.wt.trt.int2 <- glmer(pflower ~ size + winter.mean.max.temp*trt + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.wt.trt.int3 <- glmer(pflower ~ size*trt + winter.mean.max.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
fm.wt.trt.int4 <- glmer(pflower ~ size*trt + trt*winter.mean.max.temp + (1|Plot) + (1|Year), data = lom, family = "binomial")
```

```{r save survival}
surv_AICc2 <- surv_AICc |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |> 
  arrange(AICc)

get_fixed_formula <- function(m) {
  f <- formula(m)
  rhs <- deparse(f[[3]], width.cutoff = 500)
  rhs <- paste(rhs, collapse = "")
  rhs <- gsub("\\s*\\+?\\s*\\(1\\s*\\|\\s*\\w+\\)", "", rhs)
  #rhs <- gsub("\\s*\\+?\\s*offset\\(log\\(total1\\)\\)", "", rhs)  # strip offset term
  #rhs <- gsub("log.no.stems", "size", rhs)                    # rename density term
  trimws(rhs)
}

fixed_formulas <- sapply(surv, get_fixed_formula)

surv_AICc2$fixed_effects <- fixed_formulas[surv_AICc2$Modnames]
```

##p(est)
```{r}
#seeds to seedlings proxy:
#seedlings in year t is a function of the number of seeds in the plot in the year prior
#so to get the transition rate: number of seedlings in t/#seeds year t-1
#this is tricky because some years these were surveyed in different places
#so, to solve this, 
#go through and exclude plot:year transitions where seedlings werent surveyed in whole plot
#we have seed counts for all flowering plants for 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and then subsets for 2023
#we have new plants surveyed everywhere in 2022 and 2023, and then subsets 2024-2026

#Reliable transitions:
#all from 2021 seeds -> 2022 seedlings
#all from 2022 seeds -> 2023 seedlings
# 2023 seeds -> 2024 seedlings: for plot 14 (XCoor 0-3), plots 1, 3, 6, 4, 10 (0-9), plot 12 (10-19)
# 2024 seeds -> 2025 seedlings: for: plot 14 (0-3), plots 1, 3, 6, 4, 10 (0-9)
# 2025 seeds -> 2026 seedlings: for: plot 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10,12, 13, 14 and 15 (0-9), and 9, 11 (10-19)
#get seeds on their own:
seeds.subset <- lom %>% 
  filter(no.seeds>0) |> 
  filter(
    # 2021 and 2022 seeds: keep everything
    Year %in% c(2021, 2022) |

    # 2023 seeds -> 2024 seedlings
    (Year == 2023 & (
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6, 10) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot == 12 & between(Xcoor, 10, 19))
    )) |

    # 2024 seeds -> 2025 seedlings
    (Year == 2024 & (
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6, 10) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9))
    )) |

    # 2025 seeds -> 2026 seedlings
    (Year == 2025 & (
      (Plot %in% c(1:7, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot %in% c(9, 11) & between(Xcoor, 10, 19))
    ))
  ) |> 
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plants    = n(),
    total_seeds = sum(no.seeds, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Plot)

  filter(Year != "2017")%>% 
  filter(pflower !="1", !is.na(pflower), !is.na(Leaf.length), No.leaves <2 & Leaf.length<10)

lom.new_subset <- lom.new %>%
  filter(
    Year %in% c(2021, 2022) |
    (Year == 2023 & (
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6, 10) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot == 12 & between(Xcoor, 10, 19)))) |
    (Year == 2024 & (
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6, 10) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)))) |
    (Year == 2025 & (
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 6, 4, 10, 12) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(9, 11) & between(Xcoor, 10, 19))))|
    (Year == 2026 & (
      (Plot = 14)|
      (Plot %in% c(1:7, 10, 12, 13, 15) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot %in% c(9, 11) & between(Xcoor, 10, 19))))) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  count(Year, Plot, name = "seedlings_t") |> 
  ungroup()

#sum of seeds in those places in t
lom.seeds_subset <- lom %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(no.seeds)) %>%
  filter(
    Year %in% c(2021, 2022) |
    (Year == 2023 & (
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 4, 6, 10) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)))) |
    (Year == 2024 & (
      (Plot %in% c(1, 3, 6, 4, 10, 12) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot == 14 & between(Xcoor, 0, 3)) |
      (Plot %in% c(9, 11) & between(Xcoor, 10, 19)))) |
    (Year == 2025 & (
      (Plot = 14)|
      (Plot %in% c(1:7, 10, 12, 13, 15) & between(Xcoor, 0, 9)) |
      (Plot %in% c(9, 11) & between(Xcoor, 10, 19))))) %>%
  group_by(Year, Plot) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seeds = sum(no.seeds, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Plot) |> complete(Plot, Year = c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024", "2025", "2026"), fill = list(seedlings_t = 0))

germ <- left_join(lom.new_subset, lom.seeds_subset) |> 
  group_by(Plot) |> 
  arrange(Year) |> 
  mutate(seedlings_t1 = lead(seedlings_t)) |> 
  select(Plot, Year, total_seeds, seedlings_t1) |> 
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarize(seeds = sum(total_seeds, na.rm =T),
            seedlings_t1  = sum(seedlings_t1, na.rm =T),
            germ_rate = signif(seedlings_t1/seeds, 3)) |> 
  filter(Year != "2026")
germ <- germ |> 
  bind_rows(
    tibble(Year = c("overall.mean.germ", "seed.addition.germ"),
           germ_rate = c(mean(germ$germ_rate), 0.00905))
  )

overall.mean.germ <- mean(germ$germ_rate) #coarse! but need to go through and look at where seeds vs seedlings were surveyed
overall.sd.germ <- sd(germ$germ_rate)
#0.0184 for overall mean
#pest <- 0.00905 #from scott's fancy calculations from the seed addition
#germ.rate = number of seedlings from total seeds in same area of plot

write.csv(germ, here("clean_data", "Lomatium_seed_germination_rates.csv"), row.names = F)
```
